acceptance.criteria: A missing local Windows Codex App Server is reported with an actionable configuration path.
acceptance.evidence: ManagedWorkerProvisioner maps CODEX_EXECUTABLE_UNAVAILABLE to a message naming AIW_CODEX_PATH and the external Worker option.

acceptance.criteria: Windows commands use explicit Restricted Token sandboxing and fail closed when the configured policy is absent.
acceptance.evidence: guarded_command writes windows.sandbox=unelevated after the permission tables. guarded_app_server rejects a missing or different Windows policy before command/exec. The command request selects the named permission profile, and the session is closed through the kill-on-close Job Object.

acceptance.criteria: Operational documentation distinguishes Linux/WSL cgroup behavior from Windows Job Object cleanup.
acceptance.evidence: EXECUTION-GUARD.md scopes cgroup creation and cgroup.kill/populated checks to Linux/WSL and documents Windows Job Object termination and active-process confirmation.
The Linux branch still applies cgroup memory, swap, pids and CPU limits, kills the cgroup, waits for populated=0 and removes the group only after confirmation.
